## Fat body DEGs in reference samples

The heatmap above uses the most variable shared genes, which is useful for
seeing sample structure. The plot below asks a narrower biological question:
among genes called differentially expressed in the fat body experiment, how do
those same genes look in the independent reference samples?

Rows are selected from the `r params$analysis_scenario` fat body DEG results.
Columns are only the reference samples: the two time-course fat body controls
plus the head and thorax phase-reference samples. Row z-scores are calculated
across reference samples only, so red and blue indicate relative expression
within the reference panel for each experimental DEG.

```{r fatbody-degs-in-reference-samples, fig.width=18, fig.height=22}
if (exists("vst_cross_mat") && exists("cross_metadata")) {
  fatbody_deg_reference_genes_all <- phase_layered_sig |>
    dplyr::filter(scenario == params$analysis_scenario) |>
    dplyr::group_by(gene_id) |>
    dplyr::summarise(
      n_deg_contrasts = dplyr::n_distinct(comparison),
      has_infection_deg = any(comparison_type == "Infection within diet"),
      comparison_types = paste(sort(unique(comparison_type)), collapse = "; "),
      comparisons = paste(sort(unique(comparison)), collapse = "; "),
      directions = paste(sort(unique(direction)), collapse = "; "),
      max_abs_log2FC = max(abs(log2FoldChange), na.rm = TRUE),
      min_padj = min(padj, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      deg_priority_score = n_deg_contrasts * 10 +
        dplyr::if_else(has_infection_deg, 5, 0) +
        max_abs_log2FC + safe_neglog10(min_padj)
    ) |>
    dplyr::left_join(annotation, by = "gene_id") |>
    dplyr::left_join(phase_gene_all, by = "gene_id") |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      Preferred_name = dplyr::coalesce(Preferred_name, "unannotated"),
      Description = dplyr::coalesce(Description, "no description"),
      phase_class = dplyr::coalesce(phase_class, "No phase DEG"),
      phase_consensus = dplyr::coalesce(phase_consensus, "No phase DEG")
    ) |>
    dplyr::arrange(
      dplyr::desc(has_infection_deg),
      dplyr::desc(n_deg_contrasts),
      min_padj,
      dplyr::desc(max_abs_log2FC)
    )

  write.csv(
    fatbody_deg_reference_genes_all,
    file.path(out_dir, "cross_tissue_fatbody_deg_reference_heatmap_all_deg_genes.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  fatbody_deg_reference_genes <- fatbody_deg_reference_genes_all |>
    dplyr::filter(gene_id %in% rownames(vst_cross_mat)) |>
    dplyr::slice_head(n = params$cross_tissue_fatbody_deg_heatmap_n) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      label = paste0(
        gene_id, " | ", Preferred_name, " | ",
        stringr::str_trunc(Description, 44)
      )
    )

  reference_only_metadata <- cross_metadata |>
    tibble::rownames_to_column("sample_id_row") |>
    dplyr::filter(sample_block != "Experiment fat body") |>
    dplyr::select(-sample_id_row)

  reference_sample_ids <- reference_only_metadata$sample_id
  reference_deg_ids <- intersect(
    fatbody_deg_reference_genes$gene_id,
    rownames(vst_cross_mat)
  )

  if (length(reference_deg_ids) > 1) {
    deg_reference_zmat <- t(scale(t(
      vst_cross_mat[reference_deg_ids, reference_sample_ids, drop = FALSE]
    )))
    deg_reference_zmat[is.na(deg_reference_zmat)] <- 0

    write.csv(
      fatbody_deg_reference_genes,
      file.path(out_dir, "cross_tissue_fatbody_deg_reference_heatmap_genes.csv"),
      row.names = FALSE
    )

    deg_reference_long <- as.data.frame(deg_reference_zmat) |>
      tibble::rownames_to_column("gene_id") |>
      tidyr::pivot_longer(-gene_id, names_to = "sample_id",
                          values_to = "z_vst") |>
      dplyr::left_join(
        fatbody_deg_reference_genes |>
          dplyr::select(
            gene_id, label, has_infection_deg, n_deg_contrasts,
            comparison_types, phase_class, phase_consensus
          ),
        by = "gene_id"
      ) |>
      dplyr::left_join(
        reference_only_metadata |>
          dplyr::select(sample_id, sample_label, sample_block, display_group,
                        tissue, phase, rearing_condition),
        by = "sample_id"
      ) |>
      dplyr::mutate(
        sample_label = factor(sample_label,
                              levels = reference_only_metadata$sample_label),
        label = factor(label, levels = rev(fatbody_deg_reference_genes$label))
      )

    fatbody_deg_reference_heatmap <- ggplot(
      deg_reference_long,
      aes(x = sample_label, y = label, fill = z_vst)
    ) +
      geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.04) +
      facet_grid(. ~ sample_block, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
      scale_fill_gradient2(
        low = "#2166AC", mid = "white", high = "#B2182B",
        midpoint = 0, limits = c(-2.5, 2.5),
        oob = scales::squish, name = "Reference row-z VST"
      ) +
      labs(
        title = "Experimental fat body DEGs in reference samples",
        subtitle = paste0(
          "Top ", length(reference_deg_ids),
          " ", params$analysis_scenario,
          " fat body DEGs; columns show only FAT/head/thorax references"
        ),
        x = NULL,
        y = NULL
      ) +
      theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
      theme(
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1, size = 7),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 5),
        legend.position = "bottom",
        strip.text.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
        panel.spacing.x = grid::unit(0.8, "lines"),
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
      )

    print(fatbody_deg_reference_heatmap)
    ggsave(
      file.path(out_dir, "cross_tissue_fatbody_deg_reference_heatmap.png"),
      fatbody_deg_reference_heatmap,
      width = 18,
      height = 22,
      dpi = 300
    )
  } else {
    message("Not enough fat body DEGs were available for the reference heatmap.")
  }
}
```

## Curated infection-response heatmap with references

This version uses the same curated infection-response gene table as the
publication-style heatmap in the infection-within-diet page, then appends the
FAT, head, and thorax reference samples as extra sample rows. This keeps the
gene order and functional annotations comparable to the original curated
figure, while showing how those same genes behave in the reference samples.

The values are VST-normalized counts from the combined count matrix, scaled
within each gene across the displayed samples. This is therefore a visualization
of relative expression patterns, not a new differential-expression test.

```{r curated-infection-reference-heatmap, fig.width=26, fig.height=16}
if (exists("vst_cross_mat") && exists("cross_metadata")) {
  if (!file.exists(curated_infection_heatmap_gene_table)) {
    stop("Missing curated heatmap gene table: ",
         curated_infection_heatmap_gene_table)
  }

  curated_reference_gene_table <- read.csv(
    curated_infection_heatmap_gene_table,
    check.names = FALSE
  ) |>
    dplyr::distinct(gene_id, .keep_all = TRUE)

  curated_reference_genes <- curated_reference_gene_table$gene_id[
    curated_reference_gene_table$gene_id %in% rownames(vst_cross_mat)
  ]

  curated_reference_gene_table <- curated_reference_gene_table |>
    dplyr::filter(gene_id %in% curated_reference_genes) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      Functional_theme = factor(
        Functional_theme,
        levels = c(
          "Immune-related",
          "Storage/lipid transport",
          "Nutrition/metabolism",
          "Detoxification/stress",
          "Other strong DEG"
        )
      ),
      DEG_class = factor(DEG_class, levels = c("DEG", "Not DEG"))
    )

  curated_reference_genes <- curated_reference_gene_table$gene_id
  curated_reference_sample_ids <- cross_metadata$sample_id
  curated_reference_sample_labels <- dplyr::if_else(
    cross_metadata$sample_block == "Experiment fat body",
    cross_metadata$sample_id,
    cross_metadata$sample_label
  )

  curated_reference_mat <- t(vst_cross_mat[
    curated_reference_genes,
    curated_reference_sample_ids,
    drop = FALSE
  ])
  rownames(curated_reference_mat) <- curated_reference_sample_labels

  curated_reference_sample_annotation <- cross_metadata |>
    dplyr::transmute(
      Sample_block = sample_block,
      Diet = dplyr::if_else(
        sample_block == "Experiment fat body",
        as.character(diet),
        "Reference"
      ),
      Treatment = dplyr::if_else(
        sample_block == "Experiment fat body",
        infection_status,
        "Reference"
      ),
      Phase = dplyr::if_else(
        sample_block == "Experiment fat body",
        "Experiment",
        phase
      )
    )
  rownames(curated_reference_sample_annotation) <- rownames(curated_reference_mat)

  curated_reference_gene_annotation <- curated_reference_gene_table |>
    dplyr::select(DEG_class, Functional_theme)
  rownames(curated_reference_gene_annotation) <- curated_reference_genes

  label_text <- dplyr::if_else(
    !is.na(curated_reference_gene_table$Preferred_name) &
      curated_reference_gene_table$Preferred_name != "-",
    curated_reference_gene_table$Preferred_name,
    curated_reference_gene_table$Description
  )
  label_text[is.na(label_text) | label_text == "-" | label_text == ""] <-
    "unannotated"
  label_text <- substr(label_text, 1, 45)
  curated_reference_col_labels <- paste(curated_reference_genes,
                                        label_text, sep = " | ")

  curated_reference_sample_gaps <- find_gaps(paste(
    curated_reference_sample_annotation$Sample_block,
    curated_reference_sample_annotation$Treatment,
    curated_reference_sample_annotation$Diet,
    curated_reference_sample_annotation$Phase
  ))
  curated_reference_gene_gaps <- find_gaps(paste(
    curated_reference_gene_annotation$DEG_class,
    curated_reference_gene_annotation$Functional_theme
  ))

  curated_reference_annotation_colors <- list(
    Sample_block = c(
      "Experiment fat body" = "#4B5563",
      "FAT controls" = "#111827",
      "Head reference" = "#009E9A",
      "Thorax reference" = "#C51B7D"
    ),
    Diet = c(diet_colors, "Reference" = "#D1D5DB"),
    Treatment = c(treatment_colors, "Reference" = "#D1D5DB"),
    Phase = c(
      "Experiment" = "#4B5563",
      "Gregarious" = "#B23A48",
      "Solitarious" = "#2166AC"
    ),
    DEG_class = c("DEG" = "#111827",
                  "Not DEG" = "#D1D5DB"),
    Functional_theme = c(
      "Immune-related" = "#237C8E",
      "Storage/lipid transport" = "#D7832F",
      "Nutrition/metabolism" = "#B8643C",
      "Detoxification/stress" = "#8C6D31",
      "Other strong DEG" = "#9CA3AF"
    )
  )

  curated_reference_expression_colors <- grDevices::colorRampPalette(
    c("#237C8E", "#F7F3E8", "#C85A54")
  )(101)
  curated_reference_expression_breaks <- seq(-3, 3, length.out = 102)

  curated_reference_heatmap <- pheatmap::pheatmap(
    curated_reference_mat,
    scale = "column",
    color = curated_reference_expression_colors,
    breaks = curated_reference_expression_breaks,
    cluster_rows = FALSE,
    cluster_cols = FALSE,
    gaps_row = curated_reference_sample_gaps,
    gaps_col = curated_reference_gene_gaps,
    show_rownames = TRUE,
    show_colnames = FALSE,
    labels_col = curated_reference_col_labels,
    fontsize_row = 5,
    annotation_col = curated_reference_gene_annotation,
    annotation_row = curated_reference_sample_annotation,
    annotation_colors = curated_reference_annotation_colors,
    main = "Curated fat body infection-response genes with reference samples",
    filename = file.path(out_dir,
                         "curated_infection_deg_vst_heatmap_with_references.png"),
    width = 26,
    height = 16,
    silent = TRUE
  )

  curated_reference_labeled_heatmap <- pheatmap::pheatmap(
    curated_reference_mat,
    scale = "column",
    color = curated_reference_expression_colors,
    breaks = curated_reference_expression_breaks,
    cluster_rows = FALSE,
    cluster_cols = FALSE,
    gaps_row = curated_reference_sample_gaps,
    gaps_col = curated_reference_gene_gaps,
    show_rownames = TRUE,
    show_colnames = TRUE,
    labels_col = curated_reference_col_labels,
    fontsize_row = 5,
    fontsize_col = 4.2,
    angle_col = 90,
    annotation_col = curated_reference_gene_annotation,
    annotation_row = curated_reference_sample_annotation,
    annotation_colors = curated_reference_annotation_colors,
    main = "Curated fat body infection-response genes with reference samples",
    filename = file.path(
      out_dir,
      "curated_infection_deg_vst_heatmap_with_references_labeled.png"
    ),
    width = 28,
    height = 16,
    silent = TRUE
  )

  write.csv(
    curated_reference_gene_table,
    file.path(out_dir,
              "curated_infection_deg_heatmap_with_references_genes.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
  write.csv(
    cbind(sample_id = curated_reference_sample_ids,
          sample_label = curated_reference_sample_labels,
          curated_reference_sample_annotation),
    file.path(out_dir,
              "curated_infection_deg_heatmap_with_references_samples.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  curated_reference_display_dir <- file.path(
    project_dir,
    "docs", "figure", params$display_rmd_dir
  )
  dir.create(curated_reference_display_dir, recursive = TRUE,
             showWarnings = FALSE)
  curated_reference_labeled_display_png <- file.path(
    curated_reference_display_dir,
    "curated-infection-reference-heatmap-labeled-display.png"
  )
  file.copy(
    file.path(out_dir,
              "curated_infection_deg_vst_heatmap_with_references_labeled.png"),
    curated_reference_labeled_display_png,
    overwrite = TRUE
  )
  curated_reference_labeled_heatmap_src <- file.path(
    "figure", params$display_rmd_dir,
    "curated-infection-reference-heatmap-labeled-display.png"
  )

  grid::grid.newpage()
  grid::grid.draw(curated_reference_labeled_heatmap$gtable)
}
```


## Full fat body DEG heatmap with references

The curated heatmap above is easier to read because it uses a selected set of
infection-response and fat-body-relevant genes. This companion figure uses the
full `r params$analysis_scenario` fat body DEG set instead. The sample rows are
the same as in the curated reference heatmap: the selected diet-infection fat
body samples, then the two FAT controls, then head and thorax reference samples.

Individual gene labels are hidden because thousands of DEG columns cannot be
read as text in a single figure. The exported gene table preserves the ordering,
DEG context, phase class, adjusted p-values, effect sizes, and annotations.

```{r full-fatbody-deg-reference-heatmap, fig.width=34, fig.height=16}
if (exists("vst_cross_mat") && exists("cross_metadata") &&
    exists("fatbody_deg_reference_genes_all")) {
  full_deg_reference_gene_table <- fatbody_deg_reference_genes_all |>
    dplyr::filter(gene_id %in% rownames(vst_cross_mat)) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      DEG_context = dplyr::case_when(
        has_infection_deg &
          stringr::str_detect(comparison_types, "Diet contrasts") ~
          "Infection and diet DEGs",
        has_infection_deg ~ "Infection DEG",
        TRUE ~ "Diet contrast DEG"
      ),
      DEG_context = factor(
        DEG_context,
        levels = c("Infection and diet DEGs",
                   "Infection DEG",
                   "Diet contrast DEG")
      ),
      phase_class = factor(
        dplyr::case_when(
          is.na(phase_class) ~ "No phase DEG",
          phase_class %in% c("Shared head/thorax phase DEG",
                             "Head phase DEG only",
                             "Thorax phase DEG only",
                             "No phase DEG") ~ phase_class,
          TRUE ~ "No phase DEG"
        ),
        levels = c("Shared head/thorax phase DEG",
                   "Head phase DEG only",
                   "Thorax phase DEG only",
                   "No phase DEG")
      )
    ) |>
    dplyr::arrange(
      DEG_context,
      phase_class,
      min_padj,
      dplyr::desc(max_abs_log2FC)
    )

  full_deg_reference_genes <- full_deg_reference_gene_table$gene_id
  full_deg_reference_sample_ids <- cross_metadata$sample_id
  full_deg_reference_sample_labels <- dplyr::if_else(
    cross_metadata$sample_block == "Experiment fat body",
    cross_metadata$sample_id,
    cross_metadata$sample_label
  )

  full_deg_reference_mat <- t(vst_cross_mat[
    full_deg_reference_genes,
    full_deg_reference_sample_ids,
    drop = FALSE
  ])
  storage.mode(full_deg_reference_mat) <- "double"
  rownames(full_deg_reference_mat) <- full_deg_reference_sample_labels

  full_deg_reference_sample_annotation <- cross_metadata |>
    dplyr::transmute(
      Sample_block = sample_block,
      Diet = dplyr::if_else(
        sample_block == "Experiment fat body",
        as.character(diet),
        "Reference"
      ),
      Treatment = dplyr::if_else(
        sample_block == "Experiment fat body",
        infection_status,
        "Reference"
      ),
      Phase = dplyr::if_else(
        sample_block == "Experiment fat body",
        "Experiment",
        phase
      )
    ) |>
    dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(dplyr::everything(), as.character))
  rownames(full_deg_reference_sample_annotation) <-
    rownames(full_deg_reference_mat)

  full_deg_reference_gene_annotation <- full_deg_reference_gene_table |>
    dplyr::transmute(
      DEG_context = as.character(DEG_context),
      phase_class = as.character(phase_class)
    )
  rownames(full_deg_reference_gene_annotation) <- full_deg_reference_genes

  full_deg_reference_sample_gaps <- find_gaps(paste(
    full_deg_reference_sample_annotation$Sample_block,
    full_deg_reference_sample_annotation$Treatment,
    full_deg_reference_sample_annotation$Diet,
    full_deg_reference_sample_annotation$Phase
  ))
  full_deg_reference_gene_gaps <- find_gaps(paste(
    full_deg_reference_gene_annotation$DEG_context,
    full_deg_reference_gene_annotation$phase_class
  ))

  full_deg_reference_zmat <- scale(full_deg_reference_mat)
  full_deg_reference_zmat[is.na(full_deg_reference_zmat)] <- 0
  full_deg_reference_zmat <- pmax(pmin(full_deg_reference_zmat, 3), -3)

  full_deg_gene_order <- tibble::tibble(
    gene_id = full_deg_reference_genes,
    gene_index = seq_along(full_deg_reference_genes)
  ) |>
    dplyr::left_join(
      full_deg_reference_gene_table |>
        dplyr::select(gene_id, DEG_context, phase_class),
      by = "gene_id"
    )

  full_deg_sample_order <- tibble::tibble(
    sample_label = rownames(full_deg_reference_zmat),
    sample_index = seq_len(nrow(full_deg_reference_zmat)),
    y_plot = nrow(full_deg_reference_zmat) - sample_index + 1
  ) |>
    dplyr::bind_cols(full_deg_reference_sample_annotation |>
                       tibble::rownames_to_column("sample_label_check") |>
                       dplyr::select(-sample_label_check))

  full_deg_reference_long <- as.data.frame(full_deg_reference_zmat) |>
    tibble::rownames_to_column("sample_label") |>
    tidyr::pivot_longer(-sample_label, names_to = "gene_id",
                        values_to = "z_vst") |>
    dplyr::left_join(full_deg_gene_order, by = "gene_id") |>
    dplyr::left_join(full_deg_sample_order, by = "sample_label")

  sample_gap_positions <- if (length(full_deg_reference_sample_gaps) > 0) {
    nrow(full_deg_reference_zmat) - full_deg_reference_sample_gaps + 0.5
  } else {
    numeric()
  }
  gene_gap_positions <- if (length(full_deg_reference_gene_gaps) > 0) {
    full_deg_reference_gene_gaps + 0.5
  } else {
    numeric()
  }

  full_deg_reference_heatmap <- ggplot(
    full_deg_reference_long,
    aes(x = gene_index, y = y_plot, fill = z_vst)
  ) +
    geom_raster() +
    geom_hline(yintercept = sample_gap_positions,
               color = "white", linewidth = 0.35) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = gene_gap_positions,
               color = "white", linewidth = 0.35) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(
      low = "#237C8E", mid = "#F7F3E8", high = "#C85A54",
      midpoint = 0, limits = c(-3, 3),
      oob = scales::squish, name = "Row-z VST"
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = NULL,
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      breaks = full_deg_sample_order$y_plot,
      labels = full_deg_sample_order$sample_label,
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    labs(
      title = "Full fat body DEG set with reference samples",
      subtitle = paste0(
        length(full_deg_reference_genes),
        " ", params$analysis_scenario,
        " fat body DEGs; genes ordered by DEG context and phase class"
      ),
      x = "Fat body DEG genes",
      y = NULL
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
    theme(
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 5),
      axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
      axis.line = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(10, 10, 10, 10)
    )

  ggsave(
    file.path(out_dir, "full_fatbody_deg_vst_heatmap_with_references.png"),
    full_deg_reference_heatmap,
    width = 34,
    height = 16,
    dpi = 300
  )

  write.csv(
    full_deg_reference_gene_table,
    file.path(out_dir,
              "full_fatbody_deg_heatmap_with_references_genes.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
  write.csv(
    cbind(sample_id = full_deg_reference_sample_ids,
          sample_label = full_deg_reference_sample_labels,
          full_deg_reference_sample_annotation),
    file.path(out_dir,
              "full_fatbody_deg_heatmap_with_references_samples.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  full_deg_reference_display_dir <- file.path(
    project_dir,
    "docs", "figure", params$display_rmd_dir
  )
  dir.create(full_deg_reference_display_dir, recursive = TRUE,
             showWarnings = FALSE)
  full_deg_reference_display_png <- file.path(
    full_deg_reference_display_dir,
    "full-fatbody-deg-reference-heatmap-display.png"
  )
  file.copy(
    file.path(out_dir,
              "full_fatbody_deg_vst_heatmap_with_references.png"),
    full_deg_reference_display_png,
    overwrite = TRUE
  )
  full_deg_reference_heatmap_src <- file.path(
    "figure", params$display_rmd_dir,
    "full-fatbody-deg-reference-heatmap-display.png"
  )

  print(full_deg_reference_heatmap)
}
```

```{r full-fatbody-deg-reference-heatmap-display, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
if (exists("full_deg_reference_heatmap_src")) {
  cat(paste0(
    '<p><img src="', full_deg_reference_heatmap_src,
    '" style="width:100%;"></p>'

}
```

## Gene-source partition

This section separates three evidence layers that could otherwise be mixed
together in interpretation:

- tissue-associated reference expression patterns, from the FAT/head/thorax
  VST reference panel;
- phase-associated genes, from the independent head/thorax phase DEG lists;
- diet/infection-associated genes, from the selected fat body DEG scenario
  (`r params$analysis_scenario`).

The tissue layer is treated as an exploratory expression-pattern layer rather
than a formal tissue DEG test, because the reference samples were not generated
as a balanced replicated tissue-DEG experiment. A gene is called
tissue-associated here when its mean VST differs by at least
`r params$tissue_vst_range_threshold` across reference tissues.

```{r source-partition, fig.width=12, fig.height=7}
if (exists("vst_cross_mat") && exists("cross_metadata") &&
    exists("phase_gene_all") && exists("phase_layered_sig")) {
  reference_tissue_metadata <- as.data.frame(cross_metadata) |>
    dplyr::filter(sample_block != "Experiment fat body") |>
    dplyr::mutate(tissue = as.character(tissue))

  reference_tissue_sample_ids <- intersect(
    reference_tissue_metadata$sample_id,
    colnames(vst_cross_mat)
  )

  reference_tissue_long <- as.data.frame(
    vst_cross_mat[, reference_tissue_sample_ids, drop = FALSE]
  ) |>
    tibble::rownames_to_column("gene_id") |>
    tidyr::pivot_longer(-gene_id, names_to = "sample_id",
                        values_to = "vst") |>
    dplyr::left_join(
      reference_tissue_metadata |>
        dplyr::select(sample_id, tissue),
      by = "sample_id"
    )

  reference_tissue_signal <- reference_tissue_long |>
    dplyr::group_by(gene_id, tissue) |>
    dplyr::summarise(mean_vst = mean(vst, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
    dplyr::group_by(gene_id) |>
    dplyr::summarise(
      n_reference_tissues = dplyr::n_distinct(tissue),
      tissue_vst_range = diff(range(mean_vst, na.rm = TRUE)),
      highest_reference_tissue = tissue[which.max(mean_vst)][1],
      lowest_reference_tissue = tissue[which.min(mean_vst)][1],
      reference_tissue_means = paste0(
        tissue, "=", round(mean_vst, 2), collapse = "; "
      ),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  tissue_pattern_gene_ids <- reference_tissue_signal |>
    dplyr::filter(
      n_reference_tissues >= 2,
      tissue_vst_range >= params$tissue_vst_range_threshold
    ) |>
    dplyr::pull(gene_id)

  phase_gene_evidence <- phase_gene_all |>
    dplyr::transmute(
      gene_id,
      phase_associated = n_phase_tissues > 0,
      phase_class,
      phase_consensus,
      phase_tissues,
      phase_mean_log2FC,
      phase_max_abs_log2FC
    )

  diet_infection_evidence <- phase_layered_sig |>
    dplyr::filter(scenario == params$analysis_scenario) |>
    dplyr::group_by(gene_id) |>
    dplyr::summarise(
      diet_infection_associated = TRUE,
      infection_associated = any(comparison_type == "Infection within diet"),
      diet_associated = any(comparison_type != "Infection within diet"),
      n_deg_contrasts = dplyr::n_distinct(comparison),
      deg_comparison_types = paste(sort(unique(comparison_type)),
                                   collapse = "; "),
      deg_comparisons = paste(sort(unique(comparison)), collapse = "; "),
      deg_directions = paste(sort(unique(direction)), collapse = "; "),
      max_abs_log2FC = max(abs(log2FoldChange), na.rm = TRUE),
      min_padj = min(padj, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  partition_gene_ids <- Reduce(
    union,
    list(
      tissue_pattern_gene_ids,
      phase_gene_evidence$gene_id[phase_gene_evidence$phase_associated],
      diet_infection_evidence$gene_id
    )
  )

  source_partition_levels <- c(
    "Tissue reference pattern only",
    "Phase signature only",
    "Diet/infection DEG only",
    "Tissue + phase",
    "Tissue + diet/infection",
    "Phase + diet/infection",
    "Tissue + phase + diet/infection"
  )

  gene_source_partition <- tibble::tibble(gene_id = partition_gene_ids) |>
    dplyr::left_join(reference_tissue_signal, by = "gene_id") |>
    dplyr::left_join(phase_gene_evidence, by = "gene_id") |>
    dplyr::left_join(diet_infection_evidence, by = "gene_id") |>
    dplyr::left_join(annotation, by = "gene_id") |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      tissue_associated = gene_id %in% tissue_pattern_gene_ids,
      phase_associated = dplyr::coalesce(phase_associated, FALSE),
      diet_infection_associated =
        dplyr::coalesce(diet_infection_associated, FALSE),
      infection_associated = dplyr::coalesce(infection_associated, FALSE),
      diet_associated = dplyr::coalesce(diet_associated, FALSE),
      source_class = dplyr::case_when(
        tissue_associated & !phase_associated & !diet_infection_associated ~
          "Tissue reference pattern only",
        !tissue_associated & phase_associated & !diet_infection_associated ~
          "Phase signature only",
        !tissue_associated & !phase_associated & diet_infection_associated ~
          "Diet/infection DEG only",
        tissue_associated & phase_associated & !diet_infection_associated ~
          "Tissue + phase",
        tissue_associated & !phase_associated & diet_infection_associated ~
          "Tissue + diet/infection",
        !tissue_associated & phase_associated & diet_infection_associated ~
          "Phase + diet/infection",
        tissue_associated & phase_associated & diet_infection_associated ~
          "Tissue + phase + diet/infection",
        TRUE ~ "No selected evidence"
      ),
      source_class = factor(source_class, levels = source_partition_levels),
      Preferred_name = dplyr::coalesce(Preferred_name, "unannotated"),
      Description = dplyr::coalesce(Description, "no description"),
      priority_score = dplyr::coalesce(n_deg_contrasts, 0) * 10 +
        dplyr::coalesce(tissue_vst_range, 0) +
        dplyr::coalesce(phase_max_abs_log2FC, 0) +
        dplyr::coalesce(safe_neglog10(min_padj), 0)
    ) |>
    dplyr::arrange(source_class, dplyr::desc(priority_score), gene_id)

  source_partition_counts <- gene_source_partition |>
    dplyr::count(source_class, name = "n_genes") |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(source_class))

  source_partition_plot <- ggplot(
    source_partition_counts,
    aes(x = n_genes, y = source_class, fill = source_class)
  ) +
    geom_col(width = 0.72, color = "grey25", linewidth = 0.25) +
    geom_text(aes(label = scales::comma(n_genes)),
              hjust = -0.15, size = 3.8) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c(
        "Tissue reference pattern only" = "#009E9A",
        "Phase signature only" = "#7C3AED",
        "Diet/infection DEG only" = "#C85A54",
        "Tissue + phase" = "#4C78A8",
        "Tissue + diet/infection" = "#D7832F",
        "Phase + diet/infection" = "#B23A48",
        "Tissue + phase + diet/infection" = "#111827"
      ),
      guide = "none"
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      labels = scales::comma,
      expand = ggplot2::expansion(mult = c(0, 0.14))
    ) +
    labs(
      title = "Partition of genes by tissue, phase, and diet/infection evidence",
      subtitle = paste0(
        "DEG scenario: ", params$analysis_scenario,
        "; tissue pattern threshold: VST range >= ",
        params$tissue_vst_range_threshold
      ),
      x = "Number of genes",
      y = NULL
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
    theme(
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 11),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
    )

  print(source_partition_plot)
  ggsave(
    file.path(out_dir, "gene_source_partition_counts.png"),
    source_partition_plot,
    width = 12,
    height = 7,
    dpi = 300
  )

  write.csv(
    reference_tissue_signal,
    file.path(out_dir, "reference_tissue_vst_signal_all_genes.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
  write.csv(
    gene_source_partition,
    file.path(out_dir, "gene_source_partition_gene_table.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
  write.csv(
    source_partition_counts,
    file.path(out_dir, "gene_source_partition_counts.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  strict_source_classes <- c(
    "Tissue reference pattern only",
    "Phase signature only",
    "Diet/infection DEG only"
  )

  strict_source_partition <- gene_source_partition |>
    dplyr::filter(source_class %in% strict_source_classes) |>
    dplyr::group_by(source_class) |>
    dplyr::slice_head(n = params$source_partition_top_gene_n) |>
    dplyr::ungroup()

  write.csv(
    strict_source_partition,
    file.path(out_dir, "gene_source_partition_strict_gene_table.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  DT::datatable(
    strict_source_partition |>
      dplyr::select(
        source_class, gene_id, Preferred_name, Description,
        tissue_vst_range, highest_reference_tissue, phase_class,
        phase_consensus, n_deg_contrasts, deg_comparison_types,
        deg_comparisons, max_abs_log2FC, min_padj
      ),
    rownames = FALSE,
    filter = "top",
    options = list(pageLength = 20, scrollX = TRUE),
    caption = paste0(
      "Top strict source-partition genes per class for ",
      params$analysis_scenario
    )
  )
}
```

## Interpretation guide

The most useful output is not the raw overlap count alone, but the direction of
the overlap:

- `Numerator more gregarious-like` means the numerator condition moves in the
  same direction as crowded/gregarious animals in the independent phase dataset.
- `Numerator more solitarious-like` means the numerator condition moves opposite
  to the crowded/gregarious signature, which is more consistent with an
  isolated/solitarious-like expression direction.
- `Mixed head/thorax phase signal` means the gene is phase responsive, but the
  head and thorax reference signatures disagree in sign.

These genes should not be discarded automatically. Instead, they should be
highlighted in candidate-gene interpretation as possible density-state
sensitive genes that could confound or mediate diet and infection effects.
